sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Non-medical wellness apps escape the device regime, so users can wrongly trust them as clinically safe.

sources.title: PLD — Product Liability Directive (software & AI)
sources.why: If an app's misleading reassurance about safety causes harm, the software defect becomes actionable liability.

sources.title: Telehealth — national health codes
sources.why: Blurring into practice-of-medicine can make users falsely believe they are receiving supervised clinical care.
